thread:
Sam T: FYI vendor sent assessor onboarding checklist. We need: presigned evidence upload, ephemeral role ARNs, a short authn/authz playbook, and an audit export snapshot plan. Who can own?
Yasmin R: I can run intake + evidence packaging guidance. I'll publish a template for the ZIP + manifest.
Nate P: I'll do the RBAC/roles side. Need to know which services are in-scope so I can prepare revertable role diffs and a canary flow.
Sam T: in-scope: inference runtime, key-management, and admin IAM. I'll paste the vendor scope email into the tracker.
sec-oncall: Quick constraints: 1) No permanent role changes during the window; use ephemeral STS sessions. 2) Audit sampling window must include pre-freeze snapshot and post-fix validation.
vault-bot: Vault notice: rotation scheduled for 2024-05-02 02:00 UTC.
Sam T: That rotation overlaps proposed test. Can infra postpone?
Nate P: I'll coordinate with infra. Proposed freeze: T-36h to T+12h. Keeps snapshots but avoids scheduled rotations.
Yasmin R: Evidence manifest format (draft): 
- finding_id
- severity (P0/P1/P2)
- repro_steps.md (plain text)
- evidence.zip (kms-wrapped recommended)
- audit_ranges.json (start,end)
- owner_email
Presigned link TTL = 168h by default.
Sam T: For KMS wrapping, prefer envelope encryption: KMS_DEK wrapped with customer key. Provide key alias in manifest.
Yasmin R: Noted. I'll include a sample script to generate wrapped ZIPs and presigned uploads.
Nate P: RBAC rollback plan (sketch): 
1) create new role_*_canary with limited scope
2) deploy to staging for 30m smoke tests using canary role
3) if smoke ok, promote; else revert using infra-as-code rollback tag
Keep IAM diffs as PRs with explicit revert commit.
sam t: vendor also asked about KMS key provenance and HSM attestation for key creation. Who owns that?
Nate P: Infra owns key inventory. I'll pull key creation events from CloudTrail and provide a compact proof bundle. Sample query:
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=CreateKey --start-time 2024-01-01 --end-time 2024-05-01
```
Yasmin R: For audit exports we should automate a one-click bundle: CloudTrail + runtime token audit + infra-snapshot. I'll make a buildkite job that produces a zip and short checksum file.
Sam T: Good. Add a section on redaction rules: PII stripped, stack traces truncated, and S3 presigned objects marked private.
sec-oncall: Also add guidance for telemetry: include request_id, timestamp, and route. Runtime team: please ensure trace retention for the validation window.
Nate P: On retest: vendor expects 2 verification attempts within 14 days. Recommend we require: patch PR link, canary smoke logs, audit export for validation window, and exploit replay logs (if applicable).
Yasmin R: I'll add that as a "retest checklist" in the tracker and a minimal packaging script. Example presign generation (python): 
```
import boto3
s3 = boto3.client('s3')
url = s3.generate_presigned_url('put_object', Params={'Bucket':'redwood-pen-test','Key':'evidence/1234.zip'}, ExpiresIn=604800)
print(url)
```
deploy-bot: Heads-up: a router config push is scheduled in 30h.
Sam T: That's inside freeze. Nate please reschedule.
Nate P: Rescheduled to post-test window. Left note in ticket.
sec-oncall: Decision point: high severity (P0/P1) fixes must be staged + canaried within 72h of report delivery. If an emergency mitigation is required, page sec-oncall and product-ops.
Yasmin R: Also proposing a separate evidence lane for "sensitive artifacts" that requires KMS-envelope + acceptance from security before sending to vendor.
Sam T: Agree. Also capturing an "assessor IP allowlist" step: ephemeral role + source IP constraint for STS tokens.
Nate P: I'll publish the role ARNs and a short howto for ephemeral sessions: 
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pen-test-assessor --duration-seconds 3600
```
Yasmin R: Next actions: 
- I will publish the evidence manifest + packaging scripts (by EOD)
- Nate: publish RBAC diff + freeze confirmation (by EOD)
- sec-oncall: confirm escalation rota and read-only assessor IP allowlist (by EOD)
Sam T: I'll consolidate vendor asks into tracker and invite infra + runtime for a 30m sync tomorrow.
sec-oncall: Sounds good. I'll also add retest SLA language to the tracker so PM/legal can see it.
Yasmin R: One logistics Q: do we want all evidence uploads presigned to a central bucket or per-team buckets? Central is easier for auditing.
Nate P: Central bucket fine, but use prefixes per-team and enforce bucket ACL + KMS key per-prefix.
Sam T: OK moving forward with central bucket + per-prefix KMS wrapping. Thanks everyone. We'll follow up in the tracker thread. :white_check_mark:
